The Quest is an album by American jazz pianist Mal Waldron, released by the New Jazz in July 1962.[1] It was recorded in June 1961, with Eric Dolphy and Booker Ervin.[2] Some reissues of the album have appeared under Eric Dolphy's name.[3]

The AllMusic review by Scott Yanow stated that "the complex music (which falls between hard bop and the avant-garde) is successfully interpreted. Worth checking out".[3]
